title: Taiwanese Undergraduate Student Organization
content_html:
The Taiwanese Undergraduate Student Organization (TUSO) at the University of Wisconsin–Madison is a student organization focused on supporting Taiwanese undergraduate students and promoting Taiwanese culture to the broader campus community. Its founding year is not documented in available first-party sources. TUSO is listed as an affiliated student organization with UW–Madison’s International Student Services (ISS) office and is registered in the Wisconsin Involvement Network (WIN) directory.

TUSO describes itself as dedicated to assisting Taiwanese undergraduates on campus and to introducing Taiwanese culture to the public. The organization hosts approximately ten events per year covering educational, social, and multicultural interests, and identifies itself as non-partisan. Its resources page distinguishes TUSO from the graduate-student-oriented Student Association of Taiwan (SAT), directing graduate students to SAT instead.

TUSO has participated in notable cultural programming, including co-sponsoring a 2015 exhibition of works by Taiwanese painter Chen Cheng-po — described at the time as the first presentation of Chen’s art in the United States — in collaboration with the North American Taiwan Studies Association–Wisconsin Chapter and the Taiwan Academy in Houston. The organization maintains a Wix website, an Instagram account at @tuso.uwmadison, a Facebook page, and a Linktree.
